title: Story premise ENT014: The Queue-Cutting Chess Match
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: First in line. According to this arrow. Takeaway/theme: Optimizing a visible signal is useless when it is not the actual rule.
description: Two rivals try to stand first at a booth by constantly repositioning a floor arrow that marks the queue. They rotate themselves into an elaborate spiral and discover the booth serves numbered tickets; a quiet third customer with ticket one gets served while they untangle the arrow.
